title: Questions 143-146 refer to the following article.

October 2

CITY COUNCIL APPROVES SMART WATER METER ROLLOUT

HARLOW BOROUGH—The city council has formally proceeded with the Smart Meter Programme. On September 29, the council ------- (143) the essential budget. With that decision settled, the Office of Water Services plans to launch the rollout right away.

Digital water meters will be installed in older housing estates and small business units. Each meter will be linked to a wireless transmitter. ------- (144) These developments will greatly reduce billing errors for households and traders ------- (145). “This is a real gain for household budgets,” said Councillor Vance. ------- (146), the new network is expected to lower the borough's water loss by 25 percent.

The rollout will be finished by next summer.
